source_name: NBS – Legislatíva hub (dohľad nad finančným trhom)
why_relevant: Top-level pointer that enumerates every NBS legal/supervisory publication stream: národná legislatíva, právo EÚ, dohody o spolupráci, sprievodca právnymi predpismi, materiály na pripomienkové konanie, materiály na konzultáciu, usmernenia európskych orgánov dohľadu prijaté NBS. Best single entry point for mapping the whole A3 surface and for snowballing new sub-portals.

source_name: NBS – Sprievodca právnymi predpismi (guide to legal instrument types)
why_relevant: NBS's own taxonomy of document types and their binding force under EU and national law. This is the schema authority for classifying harvested documents (opatrenie vs metodické usmernenie vs odporúčanie vs stanovisko vs rozhodnutie) — indispensable for building a correct ontology rather than guessing.

source_name: Legacy NBS site (www.nbs.sk) – pre-migration document and news archive
why_relevant: NBS migrated to a new information architecture (nbs.sk/...) but a large legacy corpus remains addressable at www.nbs.sk/sk/... and www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/..., including older supervisory news, macroprudential commentaries and consultation evaluations. Necessary for historical depth and for recovering documents whose new-site links 404.

source_name: NBS – Zoznam registrov údajov o spotrebiteľských úveroch (list of consumer-credit data registers)
why_relevant: Points to the recognised private credit-bureau registers operating in SK (a second tier of data infrastructure actors beyond NBS itself).

source_name: data.gov.sk / data.slovensko.sk – Slovak open data catalogue (register datasets)
why_relevant: National open-data catalogue that indexes register datasets (RPO, ORSR extracts, procurement, statistics) with explicit licences — the discovery layer for legally reusable bulk register data.

source_name: Úrad vlády SR — Legislatívna rada vlády SR (mandate, membership, legislative rules)
why_relevant: Names the members and working commissions of the Legislative Council and hosts the Legislatívne pravidlá vlády SR plus the government's legislative task plans — the procedural rulebook that determines comment-period lengths and document types you can expect for any draft. Core input to the actor map.

source_name: EPC Register of Participants (SEPA scheme adherence lists)
why_relevant: Adherence registers show which SK PSPs (and which RVMs serving them) are live in SCT, SCT Inst and VOP — the best objective indicator of Slovak scheme readiness and of vendor footprints.

source_name: SBA — Členovia / Members list
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of banks and branches of foreign banks operating in SK plus associate members. POINTER data: seeds the whole private-bank actor map for other workstreams (vendor wins, tenders, PSD2/instant-payments rollouts) and lets you attribute positions to specific institutions.

source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia — Členovia / Členstvo
why_relevant: Member roster of the Slovak fintech/payments ecosystem — the pointer that maps non-bank PSPs, e-money firms, crypto and infrastructure vendors active in SK. Membership page plus the separate 'Členstvo' page for joining criteria.

source_name: SlovakFintech – legislatíva overview for payment/fintech reporting obligations
why_relevant: Community-maintained pointer list mapping SK payment/fintech legislation including NBS reporting opatrenia — useful for snowballing to instruments not surfaced by NBS site search.

source_name: FinStat – bank company profiles & filed financial statements (účtovné závierky)
why_relevant: Aggregator surfacing each bank's filed statutory accounts, legal-name history (Poštová banka → 365.bank) and register data — useful for entity resolution and for catching filings before banks post them on their own sites.

source_name: IBV NBS – FinNext conference
why_relevant: Conference run by the NBS-affiliated Institute of Banking Education, mixing NBS regulators, financial-institution leaders and fintech vendors. Speaker/partner rosters link regulatory agenda items to the vendors positioning against them — useful bridge between A3 regulation topics and vendor ecosystem.

source_name: MH SR – Príloha: Spotrebiteľské organizácie a zameranie ich činnosti (register of consumer organisations)
why_relevant: Ministry-compiled list of Slovak consumer organisations and their thematic focus — the fastest way to enumerate the NGO layer (ZSS, S.O.S., OMBUDSPOT and others) that generates conduct weak signals and represents consumers in court.

source_name: MH SR – Zoznam subjektov alternatívneho riešenia spotrebiteľských sporov (official ADR-body register)
why_relevant: Authoritative register of ADR entities, which is how you enumerate every ombudsman-type dispute body competent for financial services in SK (e.g. the Slovak Banking Association's ARS institute, registered 7 April 2016). Also links the European Commission consolidated ADR list.

source_name: Chambers Europe – Banking & Finance Slovakia rankings
why_relevant: Second independent enumeration of SK banking/finance advisers; overlaps with Legal 500 but catches different boutiques and names individual partners who are the actual authors of alerts.

source_name: ANASOFT – Referencie
why_relevant: SK software vendor whose reference material covers digital transformation of banking processes (branch time reduction, sales process). Secondary but useful for mapping the mid-tier vendor bench serving SK banks.

source_name: APIS – Referencie
why_relevant: SK vendor publishing a customer reference list surfaced by the local-language 'referencie' sweep; candidate for the mid-tier supplier bench serving financial institutions. Bank-specific content not yet confirmed — collect and verify.

source_name: Asseco Central Europe – Referencie
why_relevant: Historically Asseco Slovakia; core-banking and building-savings-bank software vendor for CE. Reference page plus banking solution pages indicate which SK financial institutions run its core banking system — the platform on which regulatory reporting changes must be implemented.

source_name: AXASOFT – Referencie (banking customer reference page)
why_relevant: Slovak vendor of payment solutions and banking information systems; its reference page names an unusually complete roster of SK banks as customers (365.bank, Tatra banka, UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia, VUB, CSOB, Privatbanka), making it a direct signal of which private banks buy payment/reporting software and from whom.

source_name: data.slovensko.sk — national open data catalogue
why_relevant: Central catalogue where Slovak public bodies are obliged to register open datasets. The place to check whether NR SR, Úrad vlády or MF SR publish machine-readable dumps of bills, votes or legislative processes rather than requiring scraping. Predecessor catalogue data.gov.sk still holds legacy datasets.

source_name: DATALAN – Referencie
why_relevant: Large SK integrator listing finance among its reference sectors; useful for infrastructure/DORA-adjacent resilience and ICT third-party spend at banks, which never appears in public portals for private banks.

source_name: EEA – Referencie filtered to 'banky a finančný sektor'
why_relevant: Slovak software house with a reference listing that is explicitly filterable to the banking/finance segment — a pre-segmented, low-noise list of bank engagements. The query-string filter makes it a cheap recurring collection target.

source_name: Ekosystém Slovensko.Digital — otvorené dáta (civic data mirrors and APIs)
why_relevant: Civic-tech project that republishes Slovak public-sector datasets as SQL dumps and REST/SQL APIs, often more usable than the originals. Potential shortcut for parliamentary and registry data underpinning the actor map.

source_name: European Commission – consolidated list of ADR/dispute-resolution bodies (SK filter)
why_relevant: EU-level cross-check on which Slovak ombudsman-type bodies are notified as competent for financial services; catches bodies missing from or lagging in the national register and supports comparison with other member states.

source_name: FIN-NET members — Slovakia (European Commission page)
why_relevant: Lists the SK out-of-court dispute-resolution bodies for financial services — which in Slovakia includes association-run schemes such as the SBA Institute of Alternative Dispute Resolution. Authoritative pointer linking self-regulatory bodies to the EU consumer-protection framework.

source_name: Finweek Bratislava – conference programme & partners
why_relevant: SK fintech/banking conference; programme and partner/sponsor pages reveal which vendors are actively selling to SK banks and which bank executives own which compliance programmes — a classic indirect procurement-signal source.

source_name: Jooble SK — aggregated compliance officer vacancies
why_relevant: Aggregator that surfaces postings from employer sites, agencies and niche boards in one place — good for discovering which employers (incl. non-bank PSPs, fintechs, shared-service centres) are hiring regulatory staff, then snowballing to the primary posting.

source_name: Konferencie.sk — SK conference directory
why_relevant: Cross-industry SK event directory; a cheap discovery layer for finance/banking/payments events run by organisers not otherwise on the radar, which then get promoted to tracked sources.

source_name: Kurzy.sk / Skolenia.sk — SK training-course aggregators
why_relevant: Aggregate the catalogues of many SK training providers in one searchable index — the cheapest way to detect a new regulation-themed course appearing anywhere in the market, then snowball to the provider.

source_name: Legal 500 – Banking, finance and capital markets: Slovakia (firm/lawyer rankings)
why_relevant: Directory that enumerates the SK banking/finance adviser universe (firms, teams, lead partners). Use it to build the complete actor map for this cell rather than relying on search serendipity.

source_name: N-Lex (EU) — Slovak national law interface to Slov-Lex
why_relevant: European Commission-maintained gateway describing the Slovak national legal database and offering a multilingual query form over it. Valuable as documentation of the SK database's structure and metadata, and as an English-language route in for non-Slovak-reading analysts.

source_name: NFQES – Referencie (qualified trust / e-signature services)
why_relevant: Qualified electronic signature / trust-service provider publishing named financial-sector implementations (e.g. Tatra Leasing online client solutions). eIDAS-driven and directly tied to regulatory-compliance procurement by SK financial institutions.

source_name: Slovak Compliance Circle (SCC)
why_relevant: Largest SK compliance-professional community (founded 2013 by the German-Slovak Chamber SNOPK with KPMG Slovensko and a law firm). Its event programme (e.g. 'DORA Regulation: A Practical Guide for Compliance Management'), member list and podcast reveal which obligations SK compliance officers are actually preparing for, and which advisers are teaching them.

source_name: slovlex-scraper (open-source Slov-Lex scraper, GitHub)
why_relevant: Community code that already solves Slov-Lex list scraping; a free head start on URL patterns and pagination behaviour for the ingestion layer. Maintenance status and current compatibility with the redesigned portal are unverified.

source_name: TEMPEST a.s. – Referencie
why_relevant: Long-established SK IT infrastructure / security / ITSM provider; reference page is a route to bank ICT-security and operational-resilience engagements relevant to DORA and NBS supervisory expectations.

source_name: Zlatá minca — SK financial product awards (nominations & results)
why_relevant: 20-year-old SK awards programme with a ~200-member expert jury across bank, insurance and investment categories, plus 'Most Innovative Bank' and 'Discovery of the Year'. Nomination lists are effectively a curated inventory of live products and new market entrants (e.g. Revolut, Interactive Brokers appearing) — an indirect map of who is regulated-and-active in SK.
